summary.text: Derrick McCollum is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 30 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he has worked as a firefighter and an EMT.

paragraphs.text: McCollum lives in Chestnut Mountain, Georgia, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps.
His career experience includes working as a firefighter and an EMT.
McCollum succeeded Emory West Dunahoo Jr. in District 30, assuming office on January 9, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Defense and Veterans Affairs Committee, the Natural Resources and Environment Committee, the Public Safety and Homeland Security Committee, the Regulated Industries Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
